title: Applying Adjustment Credit to a Replacement Tire Ticket — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
## Adjustment credit on a one-tire replacement ticket — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty

A replacement ticket balance is worked out for the one-tire replacement ticket written for an adjusted tire of a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set, settled when the tire is mounted. The credit applied is booked as a credit-applied entry on the set that issued the credit, carrying the replacement ticket number, the credit applied and the pre-tax balance the customer pays on the ticket.

### When the balance is fixed
- The balance on a replacement ticket is fixed only after the set carries a treadwear adjustment entry for every position that its latest tread inspection measured at or below the line's wear-out depth without a recorded defect.
- The balance on a replacement ticket is fixed only after every workmanship share charged on the set within thirty days before its latest treadwear adjustment carries a credit-applied entry naming that share's wheel position.
- Before the balance on a replacement ticket is fixed, no tire order on the customer's profile may stand in status ordered past the end of its hold period counted from its purchase date.


### Capability
With `apply_credit_to_replacement_ticket_eafdabc1` the customer applies a treadwear adjustment credit of their tire set toward the tire price on a replacement tire ticket that is settled when the tire is mounted. One call books one credit-applied entry on the set that issued the credit, citing the adjustment that issued it and carrying the replacement ticket number, the credit applied and the pre-tax balance the customer pays on the replacement ticket's lines after the credit; the credit applied is taken off the adjustment credit available on the set. Once booked, the set shows the lower credit balance and the history shows the entry against the ticket.

### Invocation
This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `apply_credit_to_replacement_ticket_eafdabc1` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `tire_set_id` | reference number of the tire set that holds the credit, as returned by the tire set lookup |
| `source_tire_event_id` | reference number of the treadwear adjustment entry that issued the credit, as returned by the tire activity history lookup |
| `ticket_number` | sales ticket number of the replacement tire purchase, T- followed by 8 digits, exactly as shown on that purchase |
| `amount` | credit applied toward the ticket's tire price, USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `balance_due` | pre-tax balance the customer pays on the replacement ticket's lines after the credit, USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

### Return
A receipt with `tire_event_id` (reference number of the credit-applied entry), `tire_set_id`, `ticket_number`, `amount` (USD applied), `balance_due` (USD pre-tax balance on the replacement ticket) and `adjustment_credit_balance` (USD credit still available on the set). A returned `tire_event_id` means the credit was applied.
